task.description: Retroactive half of the synthesis dogfooding plan: harvest roughly 160 verified tasks out of git history into training data. Measured starting state: no backfill or harvest command exists in rabbet or joiner (grep for backfill/harvest returns nothing); rabbet offers serve, mine-oss, export-parquet, mine-patterns, publish-hub, admin - mine-oss mines OSS code, not our own history. Scope: read Verified tasks from .gaugeblock/storypole/ledger.jsonl, use each VerificationReceipt commit_shas with base_commit_sha and head_commit_sha, extract the function bodies added in that range via miter, and emit Silver SFT records (LexicalScope plus task context to verified body) into .gaugeblock/spool/outbox.jsonl for rabbet export-parquet. Read-only over history, so it does not block GB-161 and can run in parallel. Note: rabbet is at 0.1.0-beta.1 while its siblings are 0.1.0-beta.4, worth reconciling when this lands.
task.title: Backfill training traces from Storypole-verified git history
